replicaCount.description: Solo mode permits at most one replica; team mode may scale shared-state application replicas.

enabled.description: Horizontal autoscaling is accepted only with the complete team profile.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Exact trusted reverse-proxy hop count for application HTTP requests; zero trusts no forwarded address.

DATABASE_SSL_MODE.description: PostgreSQL transport security; managed databases should retain verify-full.

POSTGRES_MIGRATION_MODE.description: Apply compatible migrations under the advisory leader lock or validate without changing schema.

POSTGRES_POOL_MAX.description: Maximum PostgreSQL connections in each application or worker pod.

BLOB_QUOTA_BYTES_PER_USER.description: Durable maximum plaintext blob bytes per owner.

BLOB_QUOTA_RESERVATION_TTL_MS.description: Lifetime in milliseconds of an abandoned streaming quota reservation.

OLLAMA_TIMEOUT.description: Standard Ollama request timeout in milliseconds for every application and worker pod.

OLLAMA_LONG_OPERATION_TIMEOUT.description: Long Ollama operation timeout in milliseconds; it must be at least OLLAMA_TIMEOUT.

OLLAMA_MAX_CONTEXT.description: Largest Ollama model context window adopted automatically in each application or worker pod.

AGENT_CLI_MODELS_ENABLED.description: Node-local agent CLIs are unsupported in team mode and must remain false there.

CODEX_OAUTH_MODELS_ENABLED.description: Node-local Codex OAuth files are unsupported in team mode and must remain false there.

jwtSecret.description: Stable JWT signing secret shared by every team application and worker replica; the empty value remains valid for solo mode.

replicaCount.description: External durable-worker replicas. An active team application requires at least one; zero is valid for full suspension or deliberate worker shutdown while application replicas are also zero.

tempSizeLimit.description: Bounded ephemeral scratch shared by no replicas and used for team-mode preflight/runtime files only.
